_about: The world's eras (Data.History.eras). name: what the chronicle calls it (a second one is 'the Second Age of ...'). effects: multipliers (war, harvest, plague, monsters, dragons, research, spread, healing, adventure: 1.0 is no change) and additions (happiness: to everyone's contentment; loyalty: to every lord's loyalty). reason: why it began, in the chronicle's words. adventure: how many take up the adventuring life (Data.Quests.adventure). The necromancer era waits for necromancers.

Peace.name: the Age of Peace
Peace.reason: the swords were long sheathed, and trade and harvest were the business of the realms

War.name: the Age of War
War.reason: war followed war, and every realm looked to its walls

Darkness.name: the Age of Darkness
Darkness.reason: pestilence and dark things walked the land

Faith.name: the Age of Faith
Faith.reason: the people, having suffered, turned to the gods and the temples

Dragons.name: the Age of Dragons
Dragons.reason: the great wyrms woke from their long sleep

Wonders.name: the Age of Wonders
Wonders.reason: the scholars' learning flowered as never before

Want.name: the Age of Want
Want.reason: the harvests failed and the granaries stood empty

Heroes.name: the Age of Heroes
Heroes.reason: heroes walked the land, and the people sang of their deeds
